name: dialog
title: Dialog and Sheet
description: Centered modal and edge-docked sheet on Radix Dialog.
example:
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'; import { Dialog, DialogClose, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogFooter, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogTrigger, Sheet, SheetContent, SheetDescription, SheetHeader, SheetTitle, SheetTrigger } from '@/components/ui/dialog'; import { Field } from '@/components/ui/label'; import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input'; export default function DialogDemo() { return (
Reject leave request The employee gets an email with your reason. Edit profile Slides in from the edge. Use for long forms.
); }
htmlExample:
<bef-dialog>
  <bef-dialog-trigger as-child><bef-button variant="outline">Open dialog</bef-button></bef-dialog-trigger>
  <bef-dialog-content>
    <bef-dialog-header><bef-dialog-title>Reject leave request</bef-dialog-title><bef-dialog-description>The employee gets an email with your reason.</bef-dialog-description></bef-dialog-header>
    <bef-input placeholder="Team is short staffed that week"></bef-input>
    <bef-dialog-footer><bef-dialog-close as-child><bef-button variant="ghost">Cancel</bef-button></bef-dialog-close><bef-button variant="destructive">Reject</bef-button></bef-dialog-footer>
  </bef-dialog-content>
</bef-dialog>
<bef-sheet>
  <bef-sheet-trigger as-child><bef-button variant="outline">Open sheet</bef-button></bef-sheet-trigger>
  <bef-sheet-content><bef-sheet-header><bef-sheet-title>Edit profile</bef-sheet-title><bef-sheet-description>Slides in from the edge.</bef-sheet-description></bef-sheet-header><bef-input default-value="Aarav Mehta"></bef-input></bef-sheet-content>
</bef-sheet>
